fastOnDeviceCandidate.change: Pack route requests and one-stop Dirt fuel windows use a bounded fastSearch corridor. Fuel windows select a small geographic cohort but return only after legal start→pump and pump→destination routes are both proven; installed cross-region seams now use the same bounded path, while multi-stop and required-first-station windows retain the full qualified planner. The returned start→pump response appends the short mapped-forecourt approach so displayed geometry closes exactly at the fuel stop; it remains explicitly labelled soft-stitch/unverified until customer-access edges are authored. Fast candidate ordering preserves the existing urban-core avoidance preference.
